name: bunker-static

scripts.test: npm run test:app && npm run test:functions
scripts.lint: node --check app.js && node --check firebase-client.js && node --check js/app.js && node --check js/auth.js && node --check js/database.js && node --check js/firebase.js && node --check database/init-database.js && npm run lint:functions

description: BUNKER is a small vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript app organized around Firebase Authentication and Realtime Database. The local pages work without a framework; cloud sign-in and notes remain disabled until you configure your own Firebase project.
